Under the directives of Mohammed bin Rashid, Dubai Humanitarian facilitates a new air bridge to deliver urgent WHO medical and health supplies to the people of Gaza. The first flight departed two days ago carrying 11 metric tonnes of essential medicines, followed by three additional flights carrying medical supplies, medicines, tents and fortified biscuits.
